subject: Demo coordination: FY planning blackout and CFO roadtrip overlap
messages:
From: Claire Wu <cfo@novamed.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@novamed.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request — Redwood pilot and procurement timing

Hi Olga / Aditya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough at last week's executive sync. We're interested in a focused demo for the CFO + FinOps team (and a technical add-on for APAC infra) to validate Redwood's cost controls and rollout model. A couple of constraints on our side:

- CFO travel: Claire will be on a roadtrip Nov 9–12 (APAC engagement) and unavailable for live exec sessions.
- FY planning blackout / spend freeze: FinOps has a short review week Nov 10–13 while they finalize a FY reset.

Proposed time (tentative): Nov 10, 10:00 PT for a 45-min exec + tech overview. If that won't work because of the blackout/travel, please advise alternate windows.

Also: procurement asked for a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a high-level pricing summary so they can map timing to the PO cycle. Can you share those?

Cheers,
Claire Wu
CFO, Novamed

Attachments: none
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — Redwood pilot and procurement timing

Hi Claire —

Thanks for the context — appreciate the heads up on the roadtrip and the FinOps window. Two quick calls-outs from our side:

- Because the CFO will be traveling Nov 9–12 and FinOps is in a short blackout the same week, the Nov 10 slot would probably not give you the executive sign-off visibility you need.
- We have APAC technical stakeholders who prefer an early-morning APAC slot (UTC+8) — if we try to squeeze a single meeting for both the execs and APAC engineers it becomes awkward logistics-wise.

Options that usually work:
- Short technical dry-run: Nov 6–8 (technical audience only, 30 mins) — good for the infra team to validate model behavior and latency in APAC.
- Full exec + technical briefing: week of Nov 16 (after the FY reset) — gives you FinOps time to finish the spend freeze review and lets Claire attend live.

I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with proposed milestones and a place for PO/contract cutoffs — use it to map to your procurement calendar. Aditya, Marcus — can you add the pricing summary and a trimmed agenda for a 30-min dry-run?

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v1.docx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Demo request — Redwood pilot and procurement timing

Claire — quick follow. Appreciate the constraints. Two pragmatic approaches that have worked for other customers in the same situation:

1) Canary / tech-only session before the blackout: Nov 7 or Nov 8 (30 mins) — walk the FinOps engineers through token-level cost breakdowns, batching examples, and a short Q&A. This doesn't require the CFO to be present.

2) Full exec briefing + procurement touchpoint: week of Nov 16 — 45 mins with execs + a 15-min procurement sync to confirm PO cutoff and SOW milestones.

A few items for procurement so they can confirm timing:
- Typical PO cutoff for our standard term/price is 10 business days prior to start date for dedicated capacity.
- For hosted pilots we can do shorter lead times (3–5 business days) but need a signed MAP + PO.

I attached a one-page pricing summary (tiered) and a trimmed agenda for the short tech dry-run. If Nov 7/8 works we can lock in a 30-min slot and record it for Claire to watch while traveling.

Next steps? If you prefer the after-reset window, happy to propose three time slots for Nov 16–20 that cover APAC and US overlaps.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

Attachments: pricing_summary_v3.pdf
From: Claire Wu <cfo@novamed.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T15:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — Redwood pilot and procurement timing

Thanks both —

Let's hold the exec portion until after the FY reset. FinOps has confirmed a short spend-freeze review Nov 10–13 and would prefer we don't run executive vendor briefings during that window.

Please do the following:
- Schedule the full exec + procurement briefing for the week of Nov 16 (preferred: Nov 17 or Nov 18, Claire's calendar permitting).
- Run a tech-only dry-run on Nov 8 (30 mins) targeted at the APAC infra team — record it and share the recording and notes so Claire can watch while traveling.
- Update the MAP with PO cutoff dates and share the final version; procurement will want the pricing_summary for the SOW.

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to the Nov 8 dry-run and the follow-up week after the reset.

Best,
Claire Wu
CFO, Novamed
